ruleset.name: ntdst-core
ruleset.description: Security-only, the posture wp-starter's gate uses for our own code: WordPress.Security and WordPress.DB sniff groups, PHPCompatibilityWP pinned to the package's floor. No style standard: PSR-12 was dropped because its noise buried the groups that catch bugs (core's global NTDST_* class names are deliberate). A false positive is annotated in the source with its reason, never excluded here (INV-13).
